name: Melatonin
summary: A naturally occurring hormone produced in the body that promotes sleep at certain times in the day based on the circadian rhythm. It is commonly available as a drug to treat insomnia and to promote a healthier sleep cycle. It is sometimes used to promote sleepfulness at the tail-end of drug experiences, though it is reported to be not particularly hypnotic.

pharmacology.text: In humans, melatonin acts as an agonist of its two cognate receptors: melatonin receptor 1 (MT1) and melatonin receptor 2 (MT2), exhibiting picomolar binding affinity at both sites, though with a modestly higher affinity for MT1. Both are G-protein coupled receptors and are typically coupled to Gi/o-type proteins. MT1 can also couple to Gq-type proteins.

uses.text: Melatonin is sometimes administered exogenously as a dietary supplement and medication. It is used in the treatment of sleep-related disorders such as insomnia and various circadian rhythm sleep disorders.
